column3: Bumped at the off - travelled strongly early - settled handy on rails - roused into effort over 2f out - closed on front pair approaching final furlong - driven to front late and stayed on strongly to win
Tracked the pace - pushed on to hit the front two furlongs out - pressed and outkicked approaching the final furlong - kept battling to finish second
Drifted right at the off and pulled hard early - hit the front - pressed and overtaken with 2f left - dropped to third inside final furlong - weakened near the line to finish third

Hampered and hesitant leaving the stalls - settled at the back of the field - with much ground to make up over 2f out but travelling fairly - moved left and made progress inside the final furlong - stayed on late without the speed to get involved in the finish
Bumped at the off - fought for control early - settled midpack - made progress from 2f out - pushed for effort with a furlong left - weakened close home to finish 5th
Pulled hard early towards the back - shifted right approaching 3f out then drifted left inside the final 2f - unable to threaten the front runners late and finished sixth
Pulling hard early - tracked front group - urged forward with 2f left - driven but faded inside final furlong to finish seventh
Settled with the group early - knocked about under pressure with 2f left - dropped away soon after - eventually well held in 8th

settled midpack early - moved through and gained ground with two furlongs left - driven to the front inside the final furlong - rival came at close range - held on with determination to score by a whisker
Settled at the back - driven into contention over a furlong out - closed hard approaching the last furlong - challenged inside final 110yds and just denied at the line
Handy early - driven with two furlongs left and battling on into the final furlong - flattened out inside the last 110 yards to finish third
Held up towards the back - urged into effort with 2f left - stayed on in closing stages to finish fourth beaten 3 lengths
Held up eagerly behind the front group early - urged forward with 2f to go - couldn't quicken inside final furlong - finished fifth
Handy in the pack early - urged forward with over 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - finished 6th
Sat close to the front pack early - urged forward with over 2f remaining - lost ground inside final furlong - finished 8th
Handy just behind pace - moved into second 3f out - pushed along over 2f out - closed to dispute inside final furlong - edged in front and held on strongly
Set the pace early - pushed on approaching 2f out - challenged inside final 2f and lost front spot early in last furlong - fought back gamely - stayed on well but narrowly outdone at the line
Settled with the group early - pushed to improve 3f out - lost ground and unable to threaten leaders inside final furlong - rallied late to move into third near the line

Sat behind the front group early - urged forward approaching 3f out - moved into third with 2f left - unable to close on leading pair over 1f out - had nothing more late and slipped back to fourth near the line
Sluggish start - settled at the rear - unable to challenge throughout - finished well held in 5th
Settled early behind the pace - held a forward spot before slipping to the back over 3f out - well held from there
Held up towards the back on the wide side - made progress 4f out - moved through strongly to hit the front 3f out - kicked away 1f out - kept going to the line unchallenged
Sat just behind the front pack on the wide side - urged up into 3rd approaching 2f out then moved into 2nd inside the final furlong - stayed on at an even effort to finish 2nd
Settled midfield early - pushed into contention 4f out and driven into second with 2f left - dropped to third inside final furlong - held that spot but couldn't find more late
Settled around midfield early - began to close ground with three furlongs left - pushed along into 5th with two to go - up to 4th inside the final furlong but unable to find more
Held up towards the back - improved into contention 4f out - pushed into 4th with 2f left - unable to find more late and finished 5th

Settled just behind the front group early - fighting for control under restraint - hit the front at halfway - pressed for effort and lost command 3f out - slipped back to 6th approaching the final 2f and unable to threaten again
Held up towards the back - shifted wide with 7f left then pushed along and made headway into 9th over 2f out - unable to threaten leaders and well held at the line
Sat handy behind the front group early - pushed along and slipped to 8th two out then 7th inside the final furlong - unable to find further gains and well held at the line
Sets the pace early - loses front spot at halfway - pressed for effort with three furlongs left - slips back through the field before fading out of contention late
Held up towards the back of the pack - made no headway from 3f out - well held throughout
Settled midpack in the early stages - pushed along in 7th with 2f left - dropped away late to finish well beaten
Settled at the back early - fighting for control - swung wide off the turn 7f out - unable to threaten from 4f out and well held
Sat close to the front early - slipped back through the pack by halfway - pushed along with 4f left - lost touch and allowed to finish steadily
Settled close to the front pair early - fighting for control in the early stages - pushed along 3f out - dropped away to finish last home
Held up towards the back - drifted wide rounding the turn 7f out - lost touch soon after and came home well beaten
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 4f left before losing touch - trailed home well beaten

Held up early - improved into fourth by halfway - upped into contention with the front group 5f out - shifted across straightening for home over 3f out - swept to the front and asked for effort 2f out - drew away and finished strongly

Slow to start - settled midfield before moving into third by the 5th furlong - up behind the pacesetter with 6 to go - advanced through the field entering the turn over 3f out - kept going without threatening the winner from 2f out
Tracked the front-runner early - dropped away 6f from home - stayed on at one gear through the straight from over 3f out - finished third
Set the pace and opened a big gap after 5f - advantage cut back approaching 6f out - shifted across nearing the home turn and driven to keep on - overtaken 3f out and dropped away inside final 2f
Sat behind the pace early - drifted through the field by halfway - asked for effort with 5f left but found nothing - allowed to drop away over a furlong out
Held up at back - urged forward with 5f left - dropped right out of contention 3f out - well held at finish
Settled at the back - made smooth progress 2f out - roused before the furlong marker - hit front inside final furlong and won comfortably

Settled behind the pace on the inside - made progress from 2f out and pressed on under the whip - closing on the front-runners inside the final furlong - grabbed second right on the line but unable to reel in the winner
Went straight to the front - driven on with over 2f left - front spot given up inside the final furlong - edged out of second in the closing strides to finish third
Settled close to the pace - pressed for effort with over 2f left - lost ground inside the final furlong to finish fourth
Settled with the pack early - asked for effort but boxed in 3f out then driven approaching 2f out - couldn't land a blow and dropped away inside final furlong
Tracked the front group wide - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong to finish sixth
Sat close to the pace - moved through to hit the front two out and pressed on - drove out and kept finding more to win
Settled in the pack early - improved into 5th three out then 4th soon after under pressure - forced into second approaching the last - stayed on at one gauge to go down by three-quarters of a length

Held up in the main bunch - serious blunder at the 1st and lost ground back towards the tail - moved into 3rd approaching 2 out and pressure applied - plugged on at one speed on the run-in to finish 3rd
Settled in the pack early - improved into 6th and driven approaching 2 out - up to 4th by the last - held that spot but found nothing more finishing 4th
Held up towards the back - urged forward after three out and up into 5th by two out - unable to threaten the front-runners finishing 5th
Went straight into command - drifted left at the 2nd - pushed along and lost the advantage 2 out - slipped to 6th by the final fence and unable to threaten again
Held up at the back - niggled forward from 7th but still struggling in 9th after 3 out - made no impact and finished well held
Settled towards the back of the pack - improved into 7th and pushed along 2 out - unable to threaten leading pair - finished well held in 8th
Sat close to the front group early - pushed along in 4th 3 out - dropped away soon after - well held at the finish
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along in 3rd with three furlongs left - dropped away soon after - well held at the finish
Settled in the pack early - upped alongside the pace by the 7th - pressed for effort 3 out but lost touch - allowed to drop away toward the finish
Struggling near the back from the off - urged into 4th - detached in 7th before being pulled up after 3 out
Held up towards the back - urged into contention at the 6th but made no headway - eased down and pulled up before 3 out
Sat close to the pace early - stumbled at the first and clipped the second - dropped away from the 7th and pulled up out of contention before three out
Held up in touch with back markers - lost ground before 3 out - eased and pulled up before 2 out

Restrained towards the back - made smooth progress to join the front rank by halfway - slipped to the front over 3f out - drew further and further from rivals inside 2f - value for more than the winning margin
Sat behind front group - moved into second spot 3f out - pressed for effort inside final two furlongs and stayed on but unable to challenge dominant winner
Sat close to front early - dropped back and urged forward with 3f left - stayed on for third
Sat behind the pace on the wide side - asked for effort with 3f left - found nothing under pressure - finished fourth
Went straight to front but under pressure - driven early and lost command 3f out - dropped away and well beaten 2f out - finished last of the group
Settled with the pack early - moved up three furlongs out - closed on the front pair two out - pushed to the front soon after - opened a gap into the last furlong and stayed on well to win

Settled at the back early - urged forward past the 4f marker - made progress with two furlongs left - moved into second a furlong out - matched strides with the winner inside the last - stayed on but edged out close home
Settled handy early - dropped away 3f out with no hope of getting on terms with the pace over a furlong out - moved into third inside the final furlong - stayed on to the line finishing third
Went straight to front early - pressed for effort and lost command with two furlongs left - dropped away final furlong to finish fourth
Sat close to front two early - urged forward 3f out then dropped back under pressure 2f out - unable to find more in closing stages finishing 5th
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - squeezed for space with 3f left and shifted right - held no prospect of winning entering the final furlong - dropped away to finish sixth

Held up early - urged on for a spell around the 4th - back in 10th 3 out - asked for effort again soon after - made strong progress before the 2 out marker - shared front spot at the last - hit the front inside the final furlong and kept going strongly to the finish

Settled midfield early - moved into contention 3rd approaching 3 out - going strongly 2 out and soon asked for effort - shared front spot at the last - overtaken inside final furlong - stayed on at one tempo to finish 2nd
Sat close to the pace early - moved into the lead at the 6th - driven along and hard-pushed approaching 2 out - lost top spot before the last and eased back to third with no more to give
Held up in the pack - improved into contention 4 out - up to 5th soon after - pressed for effort 2 out - held that spot at the last then finished 4th without further response
Settled in the pack - moved into 2nd 3 out then pressed for effort - slipped back to 4th approaching last - held on for 5th without finding more
Sat close to the front early - error at the 3rd then another blunder 4 out prompting a push along - 4th place 3 out - unable to close on the front pair thereafter and well held
Settled around midpack towards the wide side - pushed along in 6th after three out - dropped away thereafter - finished 7th
Held up towards the back - improved to 9th 3 out and driven to keep tabs - unable to make headway on the run-in and beaten well into 8th
Held up towards the back - hampered at the 6th - pushed along five out - down in eighth three out but unable to close - finished well beaten in 9th
Sat close to the pace early - slipped back through the pack by halfway - pressed for effort 3 out then faded well held
Sat close to the front pair - hint of an error at the opening fence - pushed along three out then dropped away
Settled just off the pace - brought down at the 6th
Disputed the front - came down at the 6th
Held up at back of field - struggling by halfway - eased out of contention with five to jump
Held up towards the back - suffered a heavy interference and lost jockey at the 6th
Held up early - crept into contention 2f out - pushed into second inside the final furlong - powered ahead close home to score
Set the pace - driven forward inside final 2f - came under pressure and overhauled late on - a neck second but far ahead of the remainder
Tracked front group early - pressed for effort 2f out but flattened out through the final furlong to finish third
Up with the front group - off the bridle over 2f out - unable to make any headway and finished 4th
Prominent in the pack early - pressed for effort and slipped back 2f out - kept going without finding extra to finish 5th
Slow to break - held up towards the back - pushed along with 3f left and unable to get competitive - finished sixth
Settled midfield - urged for effort with over 2f left - couldn't quicken - eventually finished 7th

Dwelt at the start - settled towards the back - made smooth progress into contention 2f out - pushed along a furlong out - hit the front inside the final furlong - edged left in the closing stages - stayed on to the line
Up with the front group - urged into contention over 2f out - challenged for the lead 1f out - stayed on well inside the final furlong but couldn't match the winner's finishing speed
Set the pace early - pushed on 2f out - overtaken and dropped to third approaching final furlong - held to that spot when bumped in closing stages finishing third

settled in the pack early - pushed along and lost ground over 2f out - unable to close on the front group approaching the final furlong - found renewed energy inside the last and finished strongly - lacked the speed to get involved in the finish - fourth beaten 2 lengths
Raced with plenty of enthusiasm early - tracked close to the pace - urged forward outside the final 3f then pressed for effort with 2f left - lost ground quickly after finishing 5th
Pulled hard early - tracking front group before dropping away over 2f out - faded to finish sixth
Close to pace early - edged nearer approaching 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong - finished 7th

Sat handy behind the front group - moved into second looking comfortable approaching 2 out - hit the front soon after - opened up a big advantage in the closing stages - driven out inside the final furlong - saw off the rest without much trouble

Sat close to the front pair early - shared control three out - edged in front for a moment two out - pressed and overtaken soon after - couldn't threaten the winner approaching the final fence and stayed on at an even gait for second
Sat behind the front pair - still going smoothly in third approaching 2 out - pressed for effort soon after - held in third from the last with no further gain
Handy early - pushed along in 4th approaching final two furlongs but unable to close on those ahead - stayed on at one tempo to finish 4th
Held towards the back early - roused into a run and improved slightly approaching 3 out - up to 7th at 2 out - stayed on at one speed without threatening to close further
Held up towards back of pack - improved into 6th with three furlongs left - pressed for effort but unable to close on front-runners - well held at the finish
Held up at the back - clipped the 1st - nudged forward approaching 3 out - a distant 8th 2 out and made no inroads
Set the pace early - drifted left over obstacles - matched up 3 out - pressed for effort soon after - lost front spot 2 out - dropped away rapidly and allowed to coast before the last
Held up towards the back of the pack - unable to make ground from 3 out - well held throughout - finished 9th
Handy in second rank early - up with the pace before coming down at the 7th
Held up in the pack - serious blunder at the 5th and dropped away - never got back into contention and pulled up before the 7th
Settled around midfield towards the outside early - pushed along before the 7th and soon lost touch - eased and pulled up before 3 out
Struggled from the off - blundered at the opening fence and driven up early - needed encouragement at the 6th - lost touch four out and was pulled up before two out

Settled behind the front group early - moving through strongly with three furlongs left - driven to the front two out - kicked away and took control soon after - stretched away in the closing stages to score readily
Settled in the pack early - pushed along and made progress with 2f left - kept going from the final furlong to finish second
Sat close to the pace holding a strong pull - pushed along with 2f left - lost momentum in the closing stages to finish third
Settled midfield early - pressed for effort with 3f left - finished with renewed purpose inside final furlong - came home fourth
Settled off the pace - pushed along with 2f left - lost touch inside final furlong - finished 5th
Settled towards the back early - pushed along with 2f left - kept plodding on same speed through the finish without threatening
Set the pace early - pushed along and lost the advantage 2f out - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish seventh
Held up at the back - made no impact - well held at the finish
Held up towards back early and pulling hard - improved through the pack after 2f - pushed along 2f out then dropped away final furlong
Settled towards rear early - improved into second passing the furlong pole - pushed to the front inside final furlong and stayed on strongly to win

Took up the running - showed a tendency to hang right and drop out from the front when pressed over 1f out - surrendered the advantage inside the final furlong and found nothing more - runner-up by 1½ lengths
Drifted left at the off - settled just behind the front group - pressed for effort with 2f left - responded to close the gap approaching final furlong then held the finish for third
Settled in the pack - eased right when asked for effort over 2f out then edged left gaining ground inside final furlong - stayed on at one rate to finish 4th
Held up towards the back - driven with over 2f left and again soon after - unable to close the gap - finished fifth
Bumped at the off - settled towards the back - squeezed for space inside final furlong - never able to challenge - finished sixth
Nudged right at the off - held a position in the chasing group - hampered over 1f out and well held
Knocked at the break - settled towards the back - pushed along over 3f out - lost touch soon after and trailed home
Pulled hard in the leading group - pushed into stride 2f out - veered sharply left over 1f out then corrected right - folded rapidly to finish ninth
Settled in the pack early - moving smoothly to join the front rank by the last - shaken up to hit the front inside the final furlong - kept finding under pressure to prevail
Settled close to front - hit the front from the 4th - pushed along and pegged back after 2 out then overtaken inside final furlong - stayed on at one level to finish second by a neck
Sent to the front early - lost the advantage 4th - driven into second spot with two out - shared the front line at the last - quickly outrun again - held on for third without finding more

Held up towards the back - made progress from three out - pushed along to join the front group wide after two out - soon under pressure and lost the advantage at the last - held on for fourth without finding more
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along in 4th after the third-last then dropped to 5th approaching the final two furlongs - unable to find more late finishing 5th
Held up in the pack - still down the order and pushed along with two furlongs left - finished with modest late progress but never got competitive - came home sixth
Settled midfield on the inside - stumbled at 3rd - pushed along in 7th after 3 out - moved into 4th 2 out but couldn't threaten leaders
Settled in the pack - pushed along in 8th after 3 out - unable to close - finished 8th
Sat close to the pace early - pressed for effort and slipped to 7th 2 out - unable to close - finished 9th
Held a forward position early - pushed along in 3rd two out - dropped away late to finish 10th
Held up in the pack from the off - unable to land a blow - eventually well beaten in 11th
Settled midpack early - blundered 4th - pressed for effort before 3 out and dropped away - finished 12th
Settled in the pack - unable to make headway from 3 out - dropped away late
Settled in the pack towards the wide side - unable to close from three out - dropped away late - finished 14th
Held up towards the back - unable to make headway from 3 out - dropped away late - finished 15th
Held up early - lacked the pace to get involved - well beaten in 16th
Settled behind the pace - improved and pushed into the front approaching the final furlong - stayed on well to the line to score
Settled towards rear early - moved up smoothly to challenge over 2f out - pressed for effort inside final furlong and stayed on strongly - denied by a half length
Settled in the pack - pushed along 3f out - moved through to challenge with a furlong left - held for pace in the closing stages
Set the gallop from the front - opened a big advantage by halfway - lost the lead inside the final furlong and fought back gamely - but faded close home to finish fourth
Held up towards back of field - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on same speed from inside final furlong - finished fifth
Settled at the back from the start - made no impression through the race - finished well held in 6th
Settled towards rear of the pack - pushed along with 3f left - dropped away inside final furlong - finished seventh
Poor start losing much ground - never in touch and outpaced throughout - trailed home last of the runners
Tracked the pace early - driven along a couple of lengths back inside the final furlong - responded to fight back and edged in front close home
Set the pace from the off - opened a healthy gap over a furlong out - edged left through the closing stages - held nothing more in reserve and was caught close home - beaten into second
Held up at the back - unable to challenge - finished third well beaten
Held a forward position early - dropped back approaching 2f out - faded inside final furlong - finished 4th
Held up towards back of field - unable to land a blow for the whole trip - eventually beaten well into fifth
Settled in the pack early - moved into third looking full of running two out - hit the front approaching the last - driven out to power clear and win comfortably
Handy near the front - pushed along into 4th two out - closed to 3rd but couldn't threaten the leader by the last - up into 2nd inside the final furlong holding on for second
Set the pace early - driven along and challenged hard 2 out - overtaken before the last - dropped to 3rd inside the final furlong with nothing more to give
Settled just behind the front pack - pushed along into 5th two out - 4th at the last unable to close and held to the line
Settled midfield - error 4 out - pushed along into 6th 2 out - held that spot to the last with nothing more in reserve
Sat close to the pace early - hit the 6th and once more three out - pushed along in 4th turning in but unable to close home
Held up at the back - driven approaching 3 out and still down in 9th 2 out - stayed on without gaining much ground late
Hesitant start and settled towards the back - crept into contention 4 out - pushed along in 8th spot 2 out - unable to close and well held at the finish
Settled around midfield - unable to make headway from 3 out - well held at the finish
Sat close to front pack early - pushed along in 2nd two out - unable to challenge - faded through the pack to finish tenth
Settled around midpack - made no headway from three out - dropped away late to finish well beaten
Settled midpack early - unable to close the gap from four out - dropped away late to finish 12th
Held up at the rear throughout - no impression made on the leaders - beaten a long way home in 13th
Held up towards the back - error at the 4th - made no impression thereafter - well held in 14th
Held up towards the back - lost touch four out - well beaten at the finish
Held up towards back - poor jump 1st - error at 2nd and parted company
Set the pace from the start - kicked clear approaching final furlong under pressure - margin narrowed late but held on to prevail
Handy in the pack early - urged forward with two furlongs left before moving into second a furlong out - pressed leader inside final furlong - stayed on but couldn't get past close home
Settled into second early - fighting for head early on - dropped a place approaching final furlong - driven and stayed on at same rate to finish third
Settled in the pack - shifted wide and improved position over a furlong out - lost placing inside final furlong and faded to finish fourth
Drifted left and hesitant leaving stalls - held up towards the back for most of the way with only slight progress 2f out - lost ground fast inside final furlong to finish well held
Held up at the back - lost place two furlongs out - lost more ground and trailed home well beaten
Slow to break - settled towards the back - made ground into contention two out - urged forward and edged right approaching the final furlong - joined the front and got up to prevail late

Went straight to front - urged forward with two furlongs left - stayed on well - driven approaching final furlong - drifted right under pressure inside final furlong - overtaken close home in a tight finish
Sat close to the front early - pressed for effort with 2f left then dropped back a furlong out - held on without further improving to finish third
Sat close to the front pair - pushed along inside the final two furlongs - hampered a furlong out but stayed on to finish fourth
Sat close to the front group early - dropped away under pressure after halfway - never able to challenge - finished 5th beaten 5 lengths
Shared front spot early - edged ahead by mid-race - asked for effort with 2f left - challenged close home but stayed in front - dug in to prevail by a whisker
Sat close to front pack early - 4th at halfway - urged forward with 2f left - into 3rd and driven approaching final furlong - finished strongly to be narrowly denied

Shared front spot early - edged behind just after halfway then squared up once more approaching 2f out - urged into second inside final furlong - held at three no further gain late beaten under a length
Sprang alertly at the break - dropped towards the back early - made progress into 5th by halfway - into 4th and pressed approaching the furlong marker before finishing strongly to the line
Held up at back of field - lost touch with pack entering straight and driven with no response 2f out - stayed on nearer finish to be fifth
Shared front early - dropped to 3rd by halfway then pushed along and slipping to 5th inside final 2f - held no more late response finishing 6th
Went straight to front - lost that spot before the 1f mark - pushed along and edged back in charge just inside the last 2f - held the advantage into the final furlong - battled on for the win
Settled in the pack early - eased left and pushed along approaching 2f out - improved into contention entering the final furlong - stuck on well to snatch second close home

Handy early with front group - pushed along over 2f out - improved into contention entering final furlong - closed on eventual winner - held effort through final stretch - edged out of second close home to finish third
Settled at the back early - pressed for effort and lost touch approaching final 2f - rallied inside the last to snatch fourth close home
Went straight to front after 1f - held advantage into straight - pressed for effort and lost lead 2f out - weakened close home to finish 5th
Up with the front group - pushed along to challenge winner 2f out - denied a gap at the furlong pole and dropped back - weakened in the closing stages
Settled in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - held steady effort to the line - finished seventh
Pulled hard early - within range of the pace before pressed for effort 3f out - dropped away inside final furlong to finish eighth
Poor break - never a factor - trailed home well beaten in 9th
Up with the pace early - lost the front and slipped back to 3rd at the 4th - moved smoothly to the fore 2 out - asserted and pulled away - kept on strongly to score
Sat close to the front group early - pushed along to move into second after the penultimate flight - couldn't threaten the winner from the last and stayed on at one gear to finish second
Shared control early amid keen tension - moved in front from 4th - pressed and lost command 2 out - dropped to third soon after - unable to find more on the run-in for third
Held up at the back - driven into 5th three out - 4th approaching the last - held finishing effort thereafter
Settled off the pace in 5th - pushed into 4th approaching 2 out then dropped back to 5th by the last - unable to find more late
Held up at the rear throughout - hit the 6th and made little headway from 4 out - well held at the finish
Held up behind pace on the wide side - pushed along approaching 3 out and lost touch - dropped right away to finish last of all
Settled in second early - closed on the front-runner approaching 2f out - hit the front inside the final furlong - driven out to score
Settled close to the pace - pressing the front group inside the final furlong and a half - pushed along and kept responding - denied the front spot late but grabbed second close home
Set the pace early - came under pressure from 2f out and lost command inside the final furlong - dropped to third close home
Held up towards back - shifted through midfield 2f out - pressed for effort inside final furlong and stayed on to finish fourth
Handy with front group early - driven approaching final furlong then found extra late - stayed on to finish fifth beaten 2.5 lengths
Held up at the back - driven with a furlong left - edged forward and stayed on to finish sixth
Held up in the pack from the off - unable to land a blow - finished 7th
Held up at the back - dropped away approaching final furlong - finished well held in 8th
Settled last - pressure applied 3f out and made ground - hampered for a run just over 1f out - finished strongly to catch the front-runner and got up in the dying strides
Settled towards the back early - made strong progress over 2f out - driven approaching the final furlong - hit the front and kicked clear - eased close home and caught in the last strides
Settled midpack early - asked for effort 3f out - shifted left approaching the final furlong and stayed on - moved into third close home but held for the rest
Held up towards back of pack - crept into contention wide out 3f out and driven into second spot 2f out - lost momentum in final furlong
Held a midfield position early - driven to improve inside final 3f to move fourth - held that spot but faded late to finish fifth
Settled in third early - pushed along with 2f left - lost ground inside the final furlong - finished sixth
Sat behind front-runner in second - driven approaching 2f out and dropped back - drifted right through final stages well held
Sent straight to the front and opened up a big advantage - pushed along and margin shortened inside final 2f - overtaken with a furlong left and dropped away meekly
Held up towards the back - driven 3f out - never a factor - finished 9th
Settled at back early fighting for control - asked for effort with 2f left - moved through to hit front approaching final furlong - challenged close home - stayed on gamely to prevail by a whisker

Tracked front group early - hit front under pressure over a furlong out before being overtaken shortly after - rallied strongly inside the last to close on the winner - denied by a short margin at the line
Settled just behind the pace - urged forward 2f out - angled right approaching final furlong - stayed on to take third close home
Went straight to front - overtaken after a furlong but stayed in touch - hit the front again 2f out before being outpaced inside final furlong - dropped away over the closing stages to finish fourth
Handy early before going in front after 1f - overtaken with 2f left - dropped away in the final furlong

Settled towards the back early - moving strongly on the outside into the straight - driven to the front a furlong and a half out and drifted slightly under pressure - stayed on inside the last furlong but margin shortened at the line - held on to win
Held up towards back of the pack - shifted right when short of room early in the straight - driven up into 3rd inside final furlong - stayed on strongly to just miss out
Held up towards back early - urged forward entering final straight - moved into 6th inside last furlong - stayed on strongly to close finish third
Settled midpack early - 5th at halfway - into 4th and pushed along with 2f left - unable to close in the closing stages and finished 4th one-paced
Held up towards the back of the pack - improved into 7th with two furlongs left then pushed into second inside the final furlong - couldn't find more late and held for 5th
